bars.title: Hitstun law is universal

values.label: shove helm-loss duration, scenario constant (measured at only 12 % of cruise, below the ≥ 30 % ΔV regime)
light hull loses the helm >= 1 s at measured k >= 0.30 - gun
light hull loses the helm >= 1 s at measured k >= 0.30 - rope_throw
light hull loses the helm >= 1 s at measured k >= 0.30 - well_fling
light hull loses the helm >= 1 s at measured k >= 0.30 - collision
heavy hull at gun-scale delta-V never loses the helm (measured k <= 0.06, all sources)
one law: relative spread of helm-loss across the sources that reach matched k (light hull, k ~ 0.30): gun, rope_throw, well_fling, collision
helm-loss is monotone non-decreasing in k (light hull, gun source)

bars.notes: the feeding terrain-slam runs carried no lostHelm boolean. measured below the ≥ 30 % ΔV regime; helm duration is the scenario constant, not a measured curve, and the ≥ 1 s helm clause cannot be evaluated from it. the universal-curve sweep (one helm-loss function of ΔV ÷ cruise and attacker ÷ victim mass across guns, throws, flings and collisions) is unbenched. gun 0.4833s, rope_throw 4.1333s, well_fling 0s, collision 1.5s
